WITH A AS (
  SELECT datetime, nasdaq,
         FIRST_VALUE(nasdaq) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS base
  FROM aggreg_info
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
)
SELECT datetime AS "time",
       (nasdaq / base) * 100 AS "NASDAQ"
FROM A
ORDER BY datetime
LIMIT 300

WITH B AS (
  SELECT datetime, snp,
         FIRST_VALUE(snp) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS base
  FROM aggreg_info
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
)
SELECT datetime AS "time",
       (snp / base) * 100 AS "S&P 500"
FROM B
ORDER BY datetime
LIMIT 300

WITH C AS (
  SELECT datetime, dji,
         FIRST_VALUE(dji) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS base

WITH E AS (
  SELECT datetime, net_worth,
         FIRST_VALUE(net_worth) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS base

FROM E

LIMIT 300
